parameters.content:
### 📥 Multi-Channel Ingestion & PII Masking
- Unified Ingress for WhatsApp, Telegram, Webchat, Email
- MCIT PDPL Compliance: Masks National ID, IBAN, Cards
- Language Detection (Arabic / English)

### 👤 Identity & Session
- SubWF 02 provisions customer in Postgres
- Multi-channel identity resolution (Phone/Telegram/Email)
- Turn-by-turn history memory buffer

### 🧠 AI Cognitive Engine
- Calls local **Ollama** (`llama3.1:8b`)
- Guardrails against prompt injection
- Structured JSON classification & entity extraction

### 🔀 Intent Routing & Decision
- Escalates directly to SLA-governed Human-in-the-Loop
- Queries order/service tracking
- Queries bilingual Knowledge Base RAG

### 📤 Multi-Channel Egress & Audit
- Dispatches output via SubWF 06 to active channel
- Logs audit trails to PostgreSQL
- Returns standardized synchronous JSON
